notes.title: Valor & Victory - Autumn KO tournament open for sign-ups
notes.content:
Enjoy a new Valor & Victory Knock Out Tournament. Over 4 rounds, losers will be knocked out until only 1 winner remains. Rounds are 15 days each, so please watch out for round reminders to keep the games running.

You can sign up for the tournament [url=https://www.matrixgames.com/tournaments][u][b]here[/b][/u][/url].
The tournament follows Swiss Tournament rules: you can find the full list of rules [url=https://www.matrixgames.com/tournaments/rules][u][b]here[/b][/u][/url].

[h3]Round info:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Round #1 - Alamo at Sainte Mere Eglise[/b]
[list][*]Game Turns: 6
[*]Victory Conditions: Attacker must eliminate or pin all enemy units[/list]
[*] [b]Round #2 - Mochs Battalion Advances on Neuville[/b]
[list][*] Game Turns: 7
[*] Victory Conditions: Attacker must control all objectives[/list]
[*] [b]Round #3 - Securing St Laurent[/b]
[list][*] Game Turns: 6
[*] Victory Conditions: Attacker must control all objectives[/list]
[*] [b]Round #4 - The Le Port Bridge[/b]
[list][*] Game Turns: 6
[*] Victory Conditions: Attacker must control all objectives[/list]
[/list]

The first round will commence on [b]Monday, 7th October 2024 at 7am GMT[/b]. No further entries can be accepted after the tournament has begun.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/963870/Valor__Victory/

notes.title: Steam Workshop available for Valor & Victory
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33792772/5054b6d1f1f6937c5bf275817d82c5c53977465b.jpg[/img]

We are happy to announce that Valor & Victory is now on Steam Workshop. Mods can now be downloaded directly through Steam, [b]simply subscribe to a mod through its Steam Workshop page[/b] and the mod will be automatically installed for you for the next time you start the game.

In addition, we have a new patch live (1.02.02)! [b]Here's what's new[/b]: 

-PBEM: now return to PBEM games screen after finishing PBEM game turn

-Added option to reverse mouse map zoom

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Crash when moving next to Transport and Opportunity fire happens
[*] Crash when moving next to Stug
[*] Scenario Editor - Cannot remove units from transport when loading in draft version
[*] Scenario Editor - Units on transport now displayed when loading draft version
[*] AT gun can fire at infantry stack not in firing arc
[*] Language options available after finishing a scenario
[*] AI crashes in custom scenario when first squad to fire has a bazooka
[*] Sound sliders in options should now save correctly
[*] Mouse click delays sometimes seen when in zoom mode
[*] Cannot import scenario zip files
[/list]

notes.title: Valor & Victory - New Patch (v1.02.01) - Zoom and UI scaling now available
notes.content:
We have just released a new patch (v1.02.01) for Valor & Victory, including some of the most requested features and bringing many new fixes to the game.

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Map Zooming In and Out: the game now supports different zoom levels.
[*] We added UI Scaling in the options menu.
[*] We added music settings in the options menu.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33792772/91162a8d2d199ed2e6234f95b5415c98585b8485.gif[/img]

[b]FIXED[/b]
[list]
[*] In addition to that, the patch brings many fixes to the game.
[*] You can exit from anywhere on the map for an exit based scenario
[*] Scenario Editor always loads a saved draft exit map with British flag
[*] Panzerschreck is spelt "Panzershreck"
[*] Various map LOS issues
[*] Fixed crash in PBEM when player has used smoke
[/list]

notes.title: Valor & Victory - v1.01.01 Update
notes.content:
We have released the second patch for Valor & Victory with some fixes and improvements: 

- Victory correctly applied when playing single player as defender in Objective game and winning
- KubelWagen not firing in opportunity fire
- In rare case Firelane applied in wrong hexes
- Hanomag with passengers will not use the passengers APFP in opportunity fire
- Wrong British flag used for objectives and Exit hexes

notes.title: Valor & Victory - First patch, v1.01.00
notes.content:
We have just released the first patch for Valor & Victory, including fixes (thanks for your reports!) and improvements.

Our next updates after this will address other feedback, such as the ability to zoom in and out - sorry we couldn't get it into this first patch.


[h3]NEW[/h3]
New Victory Popups
- Player now gets points
- Player can see % losses on both sides

[h3]FIXED[/h3]
- Points now sent to PBEM as game progresses
- Cannot switch to English if using PC set to another language
- Cannot unload units that are loaded into a vehicle during the game
- Pressing the Esc key to unselect units in movement can cause them to be unresponsive after
- Game hangs when AI fires AT weapon from pinned unit
- Crash when AI vehicle cannot find a target to move towards
- Crash when sometimes unselecting units
- Updated French translations
- Updated Spanish translations
- Correct British Flag

notes.title: Valor & Victory - How to play #3
notes.content:
[b]Valor & Victory [/b]is going to be released on June 17th. In this third tutorial video, we will be covering the powerful [b]Scenario Editor[/b] that is included with the game. The editor allows you to create your own scenarios as well as edit existing scenarios, allowing you to extend your enjoyment of the game and share your creations with others.

[list]	[*][b]Comprehensive tools:[/b] You can change everything from what units are deployed, to defensive object placement, to the mission objectives themselves and more.
	 [/*]	[*][b]Multiplayer Compatibility:[/b] Share your creations with your friends and play the Scenarios you've created together in multiplayer mode.
	 [/*]	[*][b]Easy To Use: [/b]Simple point and click editing allows anyone of any skill level to create their own engaging missions. The limit is only your imagination.[/*][/list]
Check it out the full tutorial below:

[previewyoutube=bceTnO6lpAw;full][/previewyoutube]
